purpose: Local drift vs upstream. ONLY the overlay_changes entries can ever produce a merge conflict - they are files that also exist upstream. local_only_files have no upstream counterpart (unique filenames) and therefore can never conflict.

branch_model.main: Pure mirror of upstream/main. Never carry local commits here - GitHub's Sync fork button stays available only while this holds.
branch_model.custom: upstream/main + all local work. This is the build and deploy branch.

build_command: rebuild-sub2api.bat (tracked) - vite build, then go build -tags embed, swap, restart
conflict_hotspot_warning: frontend/src/components/account/AccountUsageCell.vue is upstream's most-churned file touching our overlay (90 commits of history). Expect conflicts there first.

overlay_notes.backend/internal/pkg/timezone/timezone.g: Windows-only necessity, not a preference. Upstream's new timezone package calls time.LoadLocation at startup using the config default Asia/Shanghai, and ships no tzdata; Windows has no system zoneinfo, so startup aborted with 'invalid timezone Asia/Shanghai' and registered no business routes - the UI loaded while every API returned 404. A blank import of time/tzdata embeds the IANA database (+415,744 bytes of binary, measured). Worth offering upstream: the app cannot start on Windows without it.
overlay_notes.recheck_after_sync: If upstream adds time/tzdata itself, drop the timezone patch.

local_only_files.note: Win11 runbook. Renamed from DEV_GUIDE.md so it never collides with upstream's own DEV_GUIDE.md.
Launcher. Tracked because being tracked restores core.autocrlf CRLF conversion for .bat (no .bat rule in .gitattributes).
Stopper. Name unique to this fork - cannot conflict.
Preflight, frontend build, go build -tags embed, timestamped backup, swap, restart. Refuses to swap on failure.
UNTRACKED on purpose: it runs 'git checkout main' internally, so if tracked the branch switch would delete the running script.
